title: One Morning, Four Machines
summary: One moment drawn four times under four console limits: a postmaster launches a mail glider off a cliff-top post office at sunrise over a waking fishing town, as Game Boy-, NES-, SNES- and GBA-style panels.
request: No verbatim user request is recorded for this piece. The brief (brief.md section 0) states the intent: "one original moment drawn four times, each time designed for its machine, so the comparison itself is the delight" and the moment: "a young postmaster launches a canvas mail-glider off the rail of a cliff-top post office at sunrise ... below, a fishing town in a cove is waking", under Game Boy-, NES-, SNES- and GBA-style limits, with an original 8-bar 116 bpm lift-off theme.

outputs.name: poster
outputs.run: python3 art/panel_gb.py && python3 art/panel_nes.py && python3 art/panel_snes.py && python3 art/panel_gba.py && python3 art/poster.py

outputs.name: b
outputs.run: python3 art/panel_gb.py && python3 art/panel_nes.py && python3 art/panel_snes.py && python3 art/panel_gba.py && python3 art/poster.py

outputs.name: sample
outputs.run: python3 sound/theme.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/05-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/05-sample.mp3
